# Pure Heart Home Health Care
> Licensed non-medical home care agency providing compassionate senior care, companionship, personal care, and dementia support across Chicago, Rockford, and surrounding Illinois suburbs.

## Overview
Pure Heart Home Health Care provides personalized in-home daily personal care and companionship for aging adults. Pure Heart specializes exclusively in non-medical home care; it does not provide skilled medical nursing or clinical therapies. Care is coordinated 24/7 by local Illinois care coordinators.

## Core Services
- Personal Care & Activities of Daily Living (ADLs): Bathing, dressing, grooming, mobility support, transfer assistance, incontinence care.
- Companionship Care: Emotional support, social engagement, meal preparation, medication reminders, light housekeeping.
- Respite Care: Planned relief for primary family caregivers, ranging from 4-hour shifts to overnight and 24/7 care.
- Alzheimer's & Dementia Support: Non-medical memory care, gentle redirection techniques, structured daily routines, and home safety oversight.
- Homemaker & Household Help: Nutrition-focused meal prep, laundry, linen changes, kitchen/bathroom tidying.
- Transportation & Errands: Escorted rides to medical appointments, pharmacy pickups, grocery shopping, and community outings.

## Communities & Service Area
- City of Chicago: Logan Square, Hyde Park, Lincoln Park, West Loop, Lakeview, Pilsen, Beverly, and all greater Chicago neighborhoods.
- Cook County Suburbs: Evanston, Oak Park, Schaumburg, Arlington Heights, Bridgeview, Skokie, Berwyn.
- DuPage County: Naperville, Wheaton, Downers Grove, Lombard, Elmhurst, Hinsdale.
- Lake County: Waukegan, Highland Park, Buffalo Grove, Libertyville.
- Will County: Joliet, Plainfield, Bolingbrook, Orland Park area.
- Kane County: Aurora, Elgin, St. Charles, Geneva.
- McHenry County: Crystal Lake, Algonquin, Woodstock.
- Winnebago County: Rockford, Loves Park, Machesney Park.

## Key Standards & Compliance
- State of Illinois Licensed Non-Medical Home Care Agency (Illinois Department of Public Health - IDPH).
- 100% Background-Checked, Fingerprinted, Bonded, and Insured Caregivers.
- 24/7 Local Care Coordinator on-call support for families.
- In-home assessments conducted within 24–48 hours; rapid care starts available.
